lba_qa.q: If 5 pens cost 60 rupees, how much will 8 pens cost?
lba_qa.a:
Cost is in direct proportion to the number of pens.

Cost of 1 pen = 60 / 5 = 12 rupees.
Cost of 8 pens = 8 x 12 = 96 rupees.

So 8 pens cost 96 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: 6 workers can build a wall in 12 days. How many days will 9 workers take to build the same wall?
lba_qa.a:
More workers means fewer days, so this is inverse proportion.
Product (workers x days) stays constant.

6 x 12 = 9 x d
72 = 9d
d = 72 / 9
d = 8

So 9 workers will take 8 days. ✅

lba_qa.q: A car travels 150 km using 10 litres of petrol. How far can it travel using 16 litres?
lba_qa.a:
Distance is in direct proportion to petrol used.

Distance per litre = 150 / 10 = 15 km.
Distance for 16 litres = 16 x 15 = 240 km.

So the car can travel 240 km. ✅

lba_qa.q: If 15 men can finish a job in 20 days, how many men are needed to finish it in 12 days?
lba_qa.a:
Fewer days needs more men, so inverse proportion.
men x days = constant.

15 x 20 = m x 12
300 = 12m
m = 300 / 12
m = 25

So 25 men are needed. ✅

lba_qa.q: 3 kg of sugar costs 120 rupees. Find the cost of 7 kg.
lba_qa.a:
Direct proportion (more kg, more cost).
Cost of 1 kg = 120 / 3 = 40 rupees.
Cost of 7 kg = 7 x 40 = 280 rupees.

So 7 kg costs 280 rupees. ✅

lba_qa.q: A water tank is filled by 4 taps in 6 hours. How long will 3 taps take to fill it?
lba_qa.a:
Fewer taps means more time, so inverse proportion.
taps x hours = constant.

4 x 6 = 3 x h
24 = 3h
h = 8

So 3 taps will take 8 hours. ✅

lba_qa.q: A map uses a scale where 2 cm represents 50 km. What distance is shown by 7 cm?
lba_qa.a:
Direct proportion.
Distance per cm = 50 / 2 = 25 km.
For 7 cm = 7 x 25 = 175 km.

So 7 cm represents 175 km. ✅

lba_qa.q: If 8 machines produce 240 items in a day, how many items can 5 machines produce in a day?
lba_qa.a:
Direct proportion (fewer machines, fewer items).
Items per machine = 240 / 8 = 30.
For 5 machines = 5 x 30 = 150 items.

So 5 machines produce 150 items. ✅

lba_qa.q: Food for 20 students lasts 15 days in a hostel. If 5 more students join, how long will the same food last?
lba_qa.a:
More students means food lasts fewer days, so inverse proportion.
students x days = constant.
New students = 20 + 5 = 25.

20 x 15 = 25 x d
300 = 25d
d = 12

So the food will last 12 days. ✅

lba_qa.q: A printer prints 90 pages in 5 minutes. How many pages will it print in 8 minutes at the same rate?
lba_qa.a:
Direct proportion.
Pages per minute = 90 / 5 = 18.
In 8 minutes = 8 x 18 = 144 pages.

So it will print 144 pages. ✅
